system.description:
You touch a willing beast. For the duration of the jutsu, while you are in contact with the willing beast, you gain the special senses or sensory features of the beast you touch for the duration.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, you no longer need to be in contact with the beast you gained the special senses from, for the whole duration.
